title: Kyiv: Explosions reported
description: Kyiv records 13 air raid alerts in single day, most since full-scale invasion, as explosions continue overnight. In total, Kyiv spent 872 minutes — nearly 15 hours — under air raid alerts throughout the day, according to Ukraine’s Foreign Ministry. The previous record appeared to be set on March 1, 2022, when Kyiv was placed under air raid alert 12 times in a single day.
